model_form: Explicit algebraic Reynolds-stress model: T1 coefficient damped by the strain invariant through guarded division, plus T2 and T3 terms.
reference: S. Wallin, A. V. Johansson (2000), "An explicit algebraic Reynolds stress model for incompressible and compressible turbulent flows", J. Fluid Mech. 403, 89-132. doi:10.1017/S0022112099007004
